expected_findings.validation_notes: MI-001 fires because mi_http is bound to a non-loopback address (10.0.10.5). Severity remains critical (severity is set by rule definition, not demoted by compensating control). However, confidence is demoted from high to MEDIUM because mi_http_trusted_clients is set, narrowing the practical attack surface. Per the MI-001 rule body's 'compensating control' note: trusted-clients presence demotes confidence by one notch.

validation_notes: Severity stays at critical (rule-defined). Confidence drops from high to medium (compensating control). This split — severity vs confidence as orthogonal axes — is the load-bearing distinction in 15_CONFIDENCE_AND_VERIFICATION.md. If the engine demotes severity instead, that's a vocabulary error.
If MI-001 fires at confidence high (no demotion), the engine is not detecting the trusted-clients compensating control. Cross-check against MI-001's body which explicitly describes this case.
If MI-001 fires at severity medium or below, the engine is conflating severity and confidence. Report this as a confidence-discipline defect.

If MI-001 fires not at all, the engine is treating the compensating control as a full mitigation. That is incorrect — IP allowlists trust source-IP integrity, which is itself attackable on shared segments.
